name: Yanai Akira
source:
One of regulars at "Blue Comet", an office lady who works at a department which develops food. Due to her tiny figure yet big breasts, she's popular among her coworkers. 

She loves otome games and yearns for a romantic relationship like in the games.

However, in reality, she sometimes hesitates as things don't go as smoothly as in the games and has no experience in romantic relationships.
But based on her experience in playing games, she sometimes indulges in fantasies of a wonderful romance.
